title: 激光实验室的控制措施

author_source: project/高校实验室安全/115_激光实验室的控制措施/src.py

points.K1: 三类控制措施：工程、管理、个人防护
points.K2: 工程控制：用硬件挡住危险
points.K3: 防护外壳和联锁：不拆不短接
points.K6: 门口的当心激光标志和警示灯
points.K7: 设备警告标签：揭开就可能有激光
points.K8: 标签不遮挡，坏了要报修
points.K9: 机器背面：链条拦住的维修区
points.K13: 激光安全负责人与管理控制

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光实验室门口，门上方警示灯亮着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a laboratory door with a laser warning sign and a glowing red lamp above it, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光实验室的控制措施。
overlay: 激光实验室的控制措施

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰抱着资料走到门口，门上方红灯亮着
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks up to the laboratory door carrying papers, the red lamp above the door glowing.
shots.narration: 阿杰来找小研，门口的红灯亮着。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 他伸手要推门，王老师在走廊叫住他
shots.prompt_en: He reaches for the door handle while the safety administrator calls to him from the corridor.
shots.narration: 他刚要推门，王老师叫住了他。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 王老师指着红灯和标志，阿杰改用手机给小研发消息
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at the red lamp and the laser warning sign, and the young male student sends a message on his phone instead.
shots.narration: 灯亮说明在出光，先联系里面的人。

shots.section_title: 三类控制措施：工程、管理、个人防护
shots.scene: 三根柱子撑起屋顶，柱顶分别是外壳、文件夹、护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three pillars holding up a roof, topped with icons of a machine enclosure, a clipboard and safety goggles. No text.
shots.narration: 激光控制措施分三类，像三根柱子。
overlay: 三类控制措施：工程、管理、个人防护

shots.section_title: 三类控制措施：工程、管理、个人防护
shots.scene: 激光器铭牌上的类别标签，箭头指向三根柱子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank class label on a laser nameplate with an arrow pointing to the three pillars. No text.
shots.narration: 先看标签上的类别，据此定措施。

shots.section_title: 三类控制措施：工程、管理、个人防护
shots.scene: 3B和4类旁边，三根柱子都又粗又牢
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two blank class tags beside three thick, firmly built pillars. No text.
shots.narration: 3B、4类激光，三根柱子都要立牢。

shots.section_title: 三类控制措施：工程、管理、个人防护
shots.scene: 事故图标大多指向缺了一根柱子的屋顶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: accident icons mostly pointing at a roof that is missing one pillar and leaning over. No text.
shots.narration: 多数事故，是控制措施没落实。

shots.section_title: 三类控制措施：工程、管理、个人防护
shots.scene: 三个图标排序：外壳第一，护目镜最后
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ranked row of three icons, the machine enclosure first, the clipboard second and goggles last. No text.
shots.narration: 先工程，再管理，防护是最后一道。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：用硬件挡住危险
shots.scene: 激光器装在封闭外壳里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser fully closed inside a protective housing on an optical table. No text.
shots.narration: 工程控制，是用硬件把危险挡住。
overlay: 工程控制：用硬件挡住危险

shots.section_title: 工程控制：用硬件挡住危险
shots.scene: 光闸翻下，截断光束
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam shutter flipping down and blocking a laser beam. No text.
shots.narration: 光闸能随时截断光束。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：用硬件挡住危险
shots.scene: 光束穿过衰减器后变淡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam passing through an attenuator and coming out much fainter. No text.
shots.narration: 衰减器把功率降下来。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：用硬件挡住危险
shots.scene: 隔壁房间的人看着屏幕远程操作
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an operator in a separate room watching the laser setup on a monitor and using a remote control box. No text.
shots.narration: 还可以远程操作、远程监控。

shots.section_title: 防护外壳和联锁：不拆不短接
shots.scene: 工程训练中心里关着机盖的激光切割机和观察窗
shots.prompt_en: A closed laser cutting machine in an engineering training workshop, its lid down and its tinted viewing window clean.
shots.narration: 外壳和观察窗，把激光关在机器里。
overlay: 防护外壳和联锁：不拆不短接

shots.section_title: 防护外壳和联锁：不拆不短接
shots.scene: 机盖一抬，联锁断开，光束立刻消失
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a machine lid being lifted, an interlock switch opening and the beam stopping at once. No text.
shots.narration: 机盖一开，联锁就让激光停下。

shots.section_title: 防护外壳和联锁：不拆不短接
shots.scene: 联锁开关被胶带和导线短接，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an interlock switch taped over and bypassed with a wire, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不准拆联锁，不准短接、绕过。

shots.section_title: 防护外壳和联锁：不拆不短接
shots.scene: 侧边送料槽开着，手伸到槽口打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a side pass-through slot opened on a laser cutter, a hand reaching near the slot crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 侧槽打开，槽口附近不站人、不伸手。

shots.section_title: 防护外壳和联锁：不拆不短接
shots.scene: 观察窗有裂纹，挂空白停用牌，旁边电话报修
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cracked viewing window on a laser cutter with a blank out of service tag and a phone beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 观察窗破了或联锁失灵，立即停用报修。

shots.section_title: 防护外壳和联锁：不拆不短接
shots.scene: 隔着观察窗拍照打勾，掀盖拍照打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone taking a photo through the closed viewing window with a tick, and a phone held at an open lid crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 想拍照，也只隔着观察窗拍。

shots.section_title: 钥匙开关与门禁联锁
shots.scene: 【实拍】激光器控制面板上的钥匙开关，手插入钥匙的特写（不出光，遮挡品牌型号）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a key switch on a laser control panel, a hand inserting the key.
shots.narration: 插上专用钥匙，才能开启激光。

shots.section_title: 钥匙开关与门禁联锁
shots.scene: 钥匙开关连到门禁，门一开光就停
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a key switch wired to a door interlock, the door opening and the laser stopping. No text.
shots.narration: 钥匙可接门禁联锁，开门就停光。

shots.section_title: 钥匙开关与门禁联锁
shots.scene: 老周拔下钥匙锁进钥匙盒，在空白登记本上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man removes the laser key, locks it in a small key box and signs a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 钥匙专人保管，用完拔下收好。

shots.section_title: 激光受控区
shots.scene: 地面划出受控区，四周围着激光防护屏障
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser controlled area marked out on the lab floor, surrounded by laser protective screens. No text.
shots.narration: 3B、4类激光，在受控区里使用。

shots.section_title: 激光受控区
shots.scene: 手持焊接工位四周拉起防护帘，杂散光被挡在里面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a handheld laser welding bay surrounded by protective curtains, the stray light kept inside. No text.
shots.narration: 四周设防护屏障，光出不去。

shots.section_title: 激光受控区
shots.scene: 受控区的门关着，无关人员被挡在门外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed door to the controlled area, an unauthorised person stopped outside with a cross. No text.
shots.narration: 门要关好，无关人员不得进入。

shots.section_title: 激光受控区
shots.scene: 区里每个人都戴着同款防护眼镜，胸前有培训徽章
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: everyone inside the controlled area wearing matching laser safety goggles and a training badge. No text.
shots.narration: 进去的人都要培训过、戴好眼镜。

shots.section_title: 激光受控区
shots.scene: 区里的反光金属物被收走
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: shiny metal objects being cleared away from the controlled area into a drawer. No text.
shots.narration: 区里清走不必要的反光物品。

shots.section_title: 激光受控区
shots.scene: 老周陪着戴好防护眼镜的阿杰走进受控区
shots.prompt_en: The older man leads the young male student, who wears laser safety goggles, into the controlled area.
shots.narration: 外来人员经同意、有人陪同才进。

shots.section_title: 门口的当心激光标志和警示灯
shots.scene: 【实拍】本校激光实验室门口的当心激光标志和出光警示灯（不拍室内光束）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a laser warning sign and a red lamp beside a laser laboratory door.
shots.narration: 门口贴当心激光警告标志。
overlay: 门口的当心激光标志和警示灯

shots.section_title: 门口的当心激光标志和警示灯
shots.scene: 标志下方的空白说明牌，配波长和类别小图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser warning sign with a blank information plate beneath it carrying a wavelength icon and a class icon. No text.
shots.narration: 旁边注明激光类别和波长。

shots.section_title: 门口的当心激光标志和警示灯
shots.scene: 门上方红灯亮起，走近的人打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the lamp above the door turning red, a person reaching for the door crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 灯亮就是在出光，未经允许不得进入。

shots.section_title: 门口的当心激光标志和警示灯
shots.scene: 窗户贴着遮光膜，光束被挡在窗内
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: laboratory windows covered with light blocking film, a stray beam stopped at the window. No text.
shots.narration: 门窗遮挡，光不能射出实验室。

shots.section_title: 门口的当心激光标志和警示灯
shots.scene: 维修的机器四周围起临时围栏，挂上警告标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a temporary barrier with a laser warning sign set up around a machine under service. No text.
shots.narration: 维修时，也要围出临时控制区。

shots.section_title: 设备警告标签：揭开就可能有激光
shots.scene: 大型切割机剖面：光从柜里经反射镜转到切割头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: inside a large cutting machine, a beam travels from a cabinet through turning mirrors to the cutting head. No text.
shots.narration: 激光在柜里产生，靠反射镜送到切割头。
overlay: 设备警告标签：揭开就可能有激光

shots.section_title: 设备警告标签：揭开就可能有激光
shots.scene: 【实拍】激光设备光路护罩上的黄色激光警告标签特写（设备停机）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a yellow laser warning label on the cover of a machine beam path.
shots.narration: 光路护罩上，贴着黄色警告标签。

shots.section_title: 设备警告标签：揭开就可能有激光
shots.scene: 护罩上的标签，后面用虚线画出隐藏的光束
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a warning label on a cover, with a hidden beam drawn behind it in dotted lines. No text.
shots.narration: 每张标签都在说：揭开可能有激光。

shots.section_title: 设备警告标签：揭开就可能有激光
shots.scene: 激光器模块的护罩，扳手去拆打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sealed laser module cover with a warning label, a spanner opening it crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 激光器模块，维修时也不要打开。

shots.section_title: 设备警告标签：揭开就可能有激光
shots.scene: 机身的警告标签和类别标签，箭头指向说明书
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a warning label and a class label on a machine body, an arrow pointing to the user manual. No text.
shots.narration: 看标签认类别，按说明书使用。

shots.section_title: 标签不遮挡，坏了要报修
shots.scene: 贴膜和贴纸盖住机身警告标签，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a protective film and stickers covering a warning label on a machine, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 贴膜贴纸，不能盖住警告标签。
overlay: 标签不遮挡，坏了要报修

shots.section_title: 标签不遮挡，坏了要报修
shots.scene: 褪色起翘的标签被换成新的
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a faded peeling warning label being replaced with a fresh one. No text.
shots.narration: 褪色、脱落、看不清，都要更换。

shots.section_title: 标签不遮挡，坏了要报修
shots.scene: 阿杰指着破损标签向小研报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points out a damaged label to the female graduate student instead of peeling it off himself.
shots.narration: 发现了就报告，不要自己撕贴。

shots.section_title: 机器背面：链条拦住的维修区
shots.scene: 大型切割机正面的安全地垫，一脚踩上机器停
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pressure safety mat in front of a large laser cutting machine, a foot stepping on it and the machine stopping. No text.
shots.narration: 大型切割机正面，有一踩就停的地垫。
overlay: 机器背面：链条拦住的维修区

shots.section_title: 机器背面：链条拦住的维修区
shots.scene: 机器背面没有地垫，入口挂着一条链条
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the back of the machine with no safety mat, a chain barrier hung across the entrance. No text.
shots.narration: 背面没有地垫，用链条拦住。

shots.section_title: 机器背面：链条拦住的维修区
shots.scene: 链条后面机器照常运动，横梁会撞人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chain barrier while the machine gantry keeps moving behind it, a person kept clear of the moving parts. No text.
shots.narration: 链条只能提醒，不会让机器停。

shots.section_title: 机器背面：链条拦住的维修区
shots.scene: 机器断电后，老李在背面校准反射镜
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer works behind the powered down machine, adjusting the beam path mirrors.
shots.narration: 背面是维修人员校准光路的地方。

shots.section_title: 机器背面：链条拦住的维修区
shots.scene: 阿杰走到链条前，退了回来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops at the chain barrier and steps back.
shots.narration: 链条挂着，就是不得进入。

shots.section_title: 光路高度避开眼睛
shots.scene: 光学平台上光束高度低于坐姿和站姿的眼睛
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam path on an optical table set below the eye level of both a seated and a standing person. No text.
shots.narration: 光路要低于坐着和站着的眼睛。

shots.section_title: 光路高度避开眼睛
shots.scene: 弯腰把眼睛降到光束平面，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person bending so that the eyes drop to the beam plane, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不要弯腰，把眼睛降到光束平面。

shots.section_title: 光路高度避开眼睛
shots.scene: 工具掉在地上：先关光闸，再弯腰捡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dropped tool on the floor, a hand closing the beam shutter first and then picking the tool up. No text.
shots.narration: 东西掉了，先关光闸再弯腰捡。

shots.section_title: 光路高度避开眼睛
shots.scene: 光束水平走，向上的一段罩上挡板
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: beams running level across the table, one upward beam section enclosed by a shield. No text.
shots.narration: 光束水平走，向上的光加挡板。

shots.section_title: 每条光束都要有终点
shots.scene: 每路光束末端都有一个黑色终止器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: every beam on an optical table ending in a black beam dump. No text.
shots.narration: 每条光束，都要有自己的终点。

shots.section_title: 每条光束都要有终点
shots.scene: 【实拍】光学平台上的光束终止器和平台四周挡板（激光关闭）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a black beam dump and surrounding side panels on an optical table.
shots.narration: 终止器接住光，挡板围住平台。

shots.section_title: 每条光束都要有终点
shots.scene: 光栅分出几束光，每束都被挡块接住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a grating splitting a beam into several beams, every one caught by a beam block. No text.
shots.narration: 分出的多束光、反射光，也全部接住。

shots.section_title: 每条光束都要有终点
shots.scene: 光束射向通道和纸箱，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam heading toward a walkway and a cardboard box, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 光束不射向通道和可燃物。

shots.section_title: 每条光束都要有终点
shots.scene: 暂停时关光闸；动过镜片后拿观察卡沿光路查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed shutter, then a person tracing the beam path with a viewing card after moving a mirror. No text.
shots.narration: 暂停就关闸，动过元件查杂散光。

shots.section_title: 准直调光先用低功率
shots.scene: 事故原因列表，调光路排第一
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an alignment icon at the top of a list of accident causes. No text.
shots.narration: 对光调试，是最容易出事的环节。

shots.section_title: 准直调光先用低功率
shots.scene: 低功率可见指示光沿着镜片一路对准
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a low power visible guide beam traced along the mirrors to align the path. No text.
shots.narration: 先用低功率可见光，把光路对准。

shots.section_title: 准直调光先用低功率
shots.scene: 两步图：关指示光，再开主激光，操作者戴眼镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two steps, the guide beam switched off and then the main laser switched on, the operator wearing goggles. No text.
shots.narration: 对准后关指示光，再开主激光。

shots.section_title: 激光安全负责人与管理控制
shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白规程夹和培训记录
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank procedure folder and a blank training record sheet.
shots.narration: 管理控制，是用制度管住流程。
overlay: 激光安全负责人与管理控制

shots.section_title: 激光安全负责人与管理控制
shots.scene: 培训、登记、实验记录三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a training session, a sign in logbook and an experiment record notebook. No text.
shots.narration: 上岗前培训，进出登记，实验记录。

shots.section_title: 激光安全负责人与管理控制
shots.scene: 老周作为激光安全负责人检查光路，举手叫停
shots.prompt_en: The older man, acting as the laser safety officer, inspects a beam setup and raises his hand to stop the work.
shots.narration: 激光安全负责人，有权检查和叫停。

shots.section_title: 激光安全负责人与管理控制
shots.scene: 受训的人操作，旁边有人监督
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a trained operator at a laser with a supervisor standing beside. No text.
shots.narration: 懂行的人操作，或在旁监督。

shots.section_title: 激光安全负责人与管理控制
shots.scene: 电话和报告单，箭头指向学院
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone and a report form with an arrow up to a college building. No text.
shots.narration: 出了事，立即报告实验室负责人。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 三根柱子
